posts.author: Satanicoaldo
posts.body:
Hey I started dealing with RPG maker 2000 last week and everything has been smooth sailing so far.
Until I got an issue.
None of the characters in my caracteres files were good enough for the vision I had for the protagonist.
I wanted an old FF black mage style character.
So I decided to customize the old lady npc sprite to fit my needs.
Issue is something went wrong and the custom character set shows up blank.
Why is that? Can someone help me out plz?

posts.author: Cherry
posts.body:
Seems like you didn't save it with 256 color indexed palette. (Importing it should show an error regarding this.)
Make sure to use a program that can handle indexed palettes. For example you could convert it back to 256 colors using IrfanView.
Also check out this:
https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2773487198&tscn=1731159056
